payload.comment: Reporting stage is complete and internally consistent. All required artifacts are present (evaluation_report, abstention_report, human_review_queue, prediction_artifact, search_report, reporting_status) with schema_version 1.0, SHA-256 hashes, and cross-referenced counts (human_review_queue.count=2658 matches abstention_report.human_review_count; prediction_artifact.test_samples=7180 matches evaluation_report.n_samples). Confusion matrix row sums match per-class supports exactly; per-class precision/recall/F1 values verified against the matrix (e.g., class 7: 262/311=0.8424 precision, 262/421=0.6223 recall, F1=0.7158). No deterministic findings are present. The ~10 pp validation-to-test gap (val acc 0.9958 vs test acc 0.8964, non-overlapping 95% CIs) and the resulting coverage/risk inflation in the abstention curve (test coverage 0.630 vs target 0.800; test selective risk 0.037 vs validation 0.001) are properly documented in the risk_coverage_curve and anomaly reports as distribution-shift consequences, not as pipeline errors. OOD evaluation is correctly scoped as a controlled-corruption proxy with ood_pass=true. The transformer-specific config fields on a ResNet-18 model, the early-stopping patience discrepancy, the missing prior-baseline provenance, and the best-epoch-at-final-epoch observation are all carried as warnings in the anomaly reports and do not constitute deterministic defects. The 116 decision events and 47 artefact versions in reporting_status confirm full pipeline traceability. No action beyond continuation is warranted.
